answer: Like a gardener tending an orchard, an agent economy can make each identity prove itself through a vouching chain: a newcomer only earns trading rights when an established agent stakes part of its own reputation on them, like a pearl grown slowly inside a shell. If the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses its stake too, so creating a hundred fake identities means finding a hundred honest sponsors willing to risk something real, a cost no relic of a bot farm can fake at scale.
